warnings: revenue basis: the filer's own total (Revenues / RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense) is used for 2 period(s) (2009-01-03, 2009-04-04) where it exceeds the contract-revenue line by >5% — the contract line is a component there

stock_issued: 1 derived quarter(s) (2011-12-31) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

eps_diluted: 9 period(s) (2020-01-04..2024-09-28) carry no EPS tag — the filed continuing-operations EPS (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerDilutedShare) is shown, only where the period reports no discontinued operations

eps_basic: 9 period(s) (2020-01-04..2024-09-28) carry no EPS tag — the filed continuing-operations EPS (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBasicShare) is shown, only where the period reports no discontinued operations

interest expense: the row mixes gross and NET figures, so it keeps the label "Interest expense"; net (income inside) for 17 period(s) 2021-01-02..2026-07-04 — including 2 filed under the gross tag whose value equals minus the filer's net interest tag for that period

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): rnd 2011-01-01, rnd 2011-12-31, rnd 2012-12-29, rnd 2013-12-28, rnd 2015-01-03, rnd 2016-01-02, rnd 2016-12-31, rnd 2017-12-30, rnd 2018-12-29, rnd 2020-01-04, rnd 2021-01-02, rnd 2022-01-01...

catch-all cash-flow quarters blanked (the two legs' filings present the section differently, so their difference is no filed figure; flagged basis_break_quarterly): other_noncash 2021-01-02 (-79,000,000 - -81,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds sbc); other_financing 2013-12-28 (-3,000,000 - 16,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds stock_issued); other_financing 2015-01-03 (-10,000,000 - 33,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds stock_issued); other_financing 2016-12-31 (-9,000,000 - 20,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds stock_issued); other_financing 2017-12-30 (-4,000,000 - 38,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds stock_issued); other_financing 2018-12-29 (-4,000,000 - 68,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds stock_issued); other_financing 2020-01-04 (-3,000,000 - 18,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds stock_issued)
sbc: the filing(s) for 7 period(s) (2009-04-04..2016-10-01) carry no such cash-flow line; read as 0 in owner's earnings, the line itself stays blank there

sbc: some periods' filings carry no listed SBC tag but do carry AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue, AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalTaxEffectFromShareBasedCompensation, ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised, StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation; owner's earnings stays blank there (the figure is unknown, not zero)

restricted cash: in 32 period(s), 2018-09-29..2026-07-04 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 32 period(s), 2018-09-29..2026-07-04 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

free cash flow: 3 period(s) (2009-01-03..2010-01-02) report discontinued operations' investing cash flows on their own line, so capex is continuing-only there — FCF and owner's earnings use continuing OCF (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations, else OCF − CashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesDiscontinuedOperations from the same filing), blank where neither is filed; the OCF line itself stays the filed total
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 39 period(s) with discontinued operations (2009-01-03..2026-01-03) — revenue is continuing-only there

growth across filing generations: 10 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): fcf (2016-12-31); fcf_per_share (2016-12-31); ocf (2016-12-31); other_financing (2011-12-31); other_noncash (2011-01-01); other_opex (2011-01-01); owner_earnings (2016-12-31); owner_earnings_per_share (2016-12-31); sga (2011-12-31, 2016-12-31)

restricted cash: 10 growth cell(s) are blank because one of the two periods deducts restricted cash and the other still counts it as cash (no figure separates it there; flagged incl_restricted_*): net_cash (FY ending 2018-12-29; quarters 2018-09-29, 2018-12-29, 2019-03-30, 2019-06-29); net_cash_per_share (FY ending 2018-12-29; quarters 2018-09-29, 2018-12-29, 2019-03-30, 2019-06-29)

power-of-ten disagreement between filings of the same period: 2 tag-period(s) where one filing's value is 10^k x another's (a scale slip); the value consistent with the tag's other periods is kept: CommonStockSharesOutstanding 2010-01-02: kept 2.72272e+08, ignored 272.3 (10-K filed 2011-03-01); CommonStockSharesOutstanding 2011-01-01: kept 2.75739e+08, ignored 275.7 (10-K filed 2011-03-01)

shifted column: 1 tag-period(s) where only the newest filing(s) carry the adjacent period's exact value (a mis-dated context, not a restatement); the earlier filings' value is kept: CommonStockSharesOutstanding 2015-01-03: kept 2.76582e+08, ignored 2.74228e+08 = the 2016-01-02 value (10-K filed 2019-02-14)
